description: Find out how much echo a room is likely to have and how much of its walls and ceiling is worth covering. Give the room's length, width and ceiling height in feet and what the room is used for. Returns an estimated echo time in seconds with a plain rating for speech, and the share of walls and ceiling Acoustic Sound Panels suggests covering as a starting point. These are estimates for planning, based on a plain rectangular room. A Free Room Analysis gives the team's recommended layout.

ceiling_height_ft.description: Ceiling height in feet, 6 to 30. Decimals are fine.

length_ft.description: Room length in feet, 4 to 400. Decimals are fine.

room_use.description: What the room is used for.

width_ft.description: Room width in feet, 4 to 400. Decimals are fine.

name: asp_calculate_room_acoustics
title: Estimate a room's echo
